experiences.summary: Omaga, Sewanue, TrackThisJob — trip algorithms, payments, real-time streaming.
description: Sewanue (Vav Technologies Indonesia): Managed all aspects of a nearby sports field booking and rental application from planning to deployment, including authentication, order processing, user reviews, and integrating Firebase as the backend.

Omaga (PT Trans Indojek Mahasiswa): Optimized trip management algorithms, financial transactions, and real-time database streaming for an online motorcycle taxi application specifically for students, while implementing real-time communication features and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
TrackThisJob (Coolva's Product): Developed an application to track and record job applications that have been submitted, helping users manage their job search process efficiently.

experiences.summary: UnilaHub e-commerce (Midtrans, RajaOngkir) and the academic portal app.
description: Crafted a tailored e-commerce application for the University of Lampung, comprising two mobile platforms: UnilaHub Public Apps and UnilaHub Research Apps.

Integrated the system with a concurrently developed RESTful API, OneSignal and Firebase for timely notifications, the Midtrans payment gateway, and the RajaOngkir API for shipping costs and delivery tracking.
Designed and developed the academic information portal application, integrated with the University of Lampung's REST API to keep data authentic.
Engaged in every development phase, from planning and design to maintenance and publication on the Play Store.
